description: IJCAI-27's style file ijcai27.sty ('Conference Style, version of November 2018', a copy of ijcai22.sty), on plain article. Not on CTAN or the engine's mirror: from FormattingGuidelines-IJCAI-27.zip, linked from ijcai.org/authors_kit. Two columns, set by the style. The first two lines are the template's own page size (ijcai27.tex l.8-9); XeTeX has both primitives. The template also loads times; it is left to the document, since under XeTeX ptm has no TU shape.
